what_this_is: The timing run (Reported beside the headline; R7, adopted by Joe on 2026-11-19, D-107): the headline set at 2% with Public Service of Colorado and Ohio Power added at their no-anchoring years, each matched at its own reference year under every existing rule; whether the seven headline hosts' matches are unchanged; each added host's rule results and matches; and the rank test made before any fit on the regressors alone. Ohio Power's matches follow the ownership code in the file when this was run. Quantities only: load, sales, customers, ownership and the usable flag; no price, revenue, bill or outcome is read and nothing is fitted. A timing run on a design on which no validation was made. PROVISIONAL: the design stands as of 2026-11-18 and the plan is a DRAFT, not frozen.
readings: the seven's matches unchanged is a condition of the run; if it fails the run is not estimated (the agent's reading)
